import os
tot=0; entries=0
for base,dirs,files in os.walk('.'):
    for name in dirs+files:
        entries+=1
        p=os.path.join(base,name)
        if os.path.isfile(p): tot+=os.path.getsize(p)

import ctypes,sys,numpy as np
ctypes.CDLL('/workspace/vendor/system-libs/libz.so.1',mode=ctypes.RTLD_GLOBAL)
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/vendor'); sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission')
from netnomos.engine import mask_to_int, int_to_mask, lowest_bit
for n in [1,2,3,7,8,9,15,16,17,63,64,65,100,1000]:
    for seed in range(5):
        rng=np.random.default_rng(seed*100+n)
        a=rng.integers(0,2,size=n).astype(bool)
        v=mask_to_int(a)
        assert v == sum(int(x)<<i for i,x in enumerate(a)), (n,seed)
        b=int_to_mask(v,n)
        assert (b==a).all(), (n,seed)
        if v: assert lowest_bit(v)==int(np.argmax(a))
print('mask helpers OK')
"
